units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:18">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> top; <cite ref="Shabbat 62b:19">Sabb. 62ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00312"><he>גּוּדָל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:2">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>אני דורך גיתה</he> … <he>בעֲקֵב רגלי</he> I shall tread Edom’s vat with the heel of my foot (v.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 12:1">Yeb. XII, 1</cite> <he>סנדל שיש לו ע׳</he> a sandal which has a sole with a covering for the heel.
Gen. R. s. 22 מתלא בעֲקֵיבוֹ swinging his heel (dandy-like); Yalk. Prov. 961 מתלה בעֲקֵיבָיו (pl.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 6:3">Zeb. VI, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Zevachim 63b:1">63ᵇ</cite>) <he>יורדין על הע׳</he> (Mish. ed. <he>חוזרים לע׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200); <cite ref="Sukkah 48b:7">Succ. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>חוזרין על הע׳</he> they turn around on their heels, i.e. go back the same way.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 272">Yalk. Jer. 272</cite> <he>דשו בע׳</he> trod with the heel, i.e. ignored it wilfully.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV, 7</cite>, <cite ref="U00490"><he>שׁוּף</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00490"><he>שׁוּף</he> I</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Nedarim 20a:11">ib.</cite> <he>במקום הטנופת שהוא מכוון כנגד ע׳</he> (Ar. <he>במקום התורפה</he>) he who gazes at the posteriors which correspond (in shape and position) to the heel.
<cite ref="Nazir 51a:11">Naz. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>רקב הבא מן הע׳</he> decayed matter that seems to come from the posteriors, Rashi (Tosaf.: the heel).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:6">Sot. VIII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 44a:13">44ᵃ</cite>) <he>עקבו של עם</he> (Y. a. Bab. ed. <he>עקיבו</he>) the rear of the people.—Pl. <he>עֲקֵבִים</he>, <he>עֲקֵבִין</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:3">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>הוא מביא לכם מבין עִקְבֵי רגליכם</he> he will bring you (the flood) from under your heels. Tanḥ. Ekeb 1 <he>מצות … ומשליכין אותן תחת עִקְבֵיהֶן</he> minor laws which people disregard and throw under their heels.
Naz. 22ᵇ הריני נזירה בעִיקְבַיִךְ I will be a Nazarite following thy heels (example); הריני בעיקביך I will follow thy example; a. e.—עִקְּבוֹת foot-steps.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 49b">49ᵇ</cite>) (in Chald. dict.) <he>בע׳ משיחא</he> (borrowed fr.
<cite ref="Psalms 89:52">Ps. LXXXIX, 52</cite>) in the footsteps of (events paving the way to) the Messiah.—[Snh. l. c. <he>ועקב שמו</he>, v. <cite ref="P01157"><he>עָקוֹב</he></cite>].
